mechanism_narrative: The observed two-week upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility indicates a sustained return of consumer activity, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: As WORKPLACES mobility continues its recent recovery and surpasses a threshold of -40% from baseline, it will signal a broader return to normal routines, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -40% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not increase relative to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility and an increase in TRANSIT mobility indicates a shift from staying at home to commuting and external activities, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to fall while TRANSIT mobility rises, but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not increase.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, the sustained high levels of PARKS mobility combined with increasing GROCERY_PHARM visits suggest increased public comfort with outdoor and essential outings, which will spill over into RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Despite sustained PARKS and increasing GROCERY_PHARM mobility in a reopening regime, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days decreases.

mechanism_narrative: The strong week-on-week recovery in RETAIL_REC observed at t-1w and t-0w indicates a short-term momentum that will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher in the immediate next week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next week, despite two consecutive weeks of >5 point increases.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility over the past two weeks signifies a sustained shift of people leaving their homes, directly correlating with increased out-of-home activities, thus boosting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below 20% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not increase.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent recovery across WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and GROCERY_PHARM mobility indicates a broad return to daily routines and essential errands, which will collectively drive an increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the average of WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and GROCERY_PHARM mobility does not continue to improve, or RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp and broad-based recovery across multiple mobility categories (RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, TRANSIT) over the last two weeks suggests an underlying policy shift towards easing restrictions, which will continue to facilitate increased RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If local policy announcements indicate a re-imposition of restrictions, or RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days despite the observed trends.
